title: The False Quarry
text: The thing in the clearing looks like the quarry, down to the scar on its flank, and is not. Its movements are a beat too late. It is wearing the quarry's shape, the way a man wears a borrowed coat, and it is waiting to see if you will notice.

outcomes.text: It sheds the quarry's shape like a coat, and what is underneath fights.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches it, and waits.

outcomes.text: It leads you to the real one without ever knowing it.

options.label: The smoothest speaks to the thing in the borrowed shape.

outcomes.text: It wants the quarry dead too, and it walks with you a while.
